repo.description:
### Impact

On sites that use censored watched words containing a wildcard (`*`), a user could craft a chat transcript (a quote of chat messages) so that censoring rewrote HTML that had already passed the sanitizer. This let the user inject HTML attributes and elements that the sanitizer would have removed, which could be used for content spoofing or to overlay parts of the page. The default Content Security Policy blocks script execution from the injected markup.

Only sites with the Chat plugin enabled and at least one censored watched word that uses a wildcard are affected.

### Patches

The censor no longer rewrites HTML that is restored after sanitization. Fixed in `2026.11.0-latest`. Fixed release versions will be added after the fix and backports are released.

### Workarounds

Remove the wildcard (`*`) from censored watched words, or delete those watched words, until a patched version is available.

### References

None.

Discovered by Anthropic's OSS Scanner, as vulnerability ANT-2026-1KUBK80U.
repo.summary: Censored watched words can inject HTML attributes into quoted chat messages
